The '''Alderath system''' was located in the [[Alderath sector/Legends|Alderath sector]],<ref name="EAOC" /> a part of the [[New Territories/Legends|New Territories]] portion of<ref name="TEA" /> the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It was situated on the [[Celanon Spur/Legends|Celanon Spur]] [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]], which linked it to the [[Korvaii system/Legends|Korvaii system]] of the [[Kordu sector/Legends|Kordu sector]] and the [[Orocco system/Legends|Orocco system]] of the [[Ottega sector/Legends|Ottega sector]]. Another [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] route connected the system to the [[Ylix system/Legends|Ylix system]] of the [[M'shinni sector/Legends|M'shinni sector]].<ref name="EGTW" /> The Alderath [[Star system/Legends|system]] shared its name with the organization known as the [[Alderath Horticultural Society]],<ref name="Alderath">{{WEGCite|story=Alderath Horticultural Society (adventure)|book=Star Wars Gamemaster Screen}}</ref> and between [[12 ABY/Legends|12 ABY]] and [[13 ABY/Legends|13 ABY]], it fell within the borders of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]].<ref name="EGTW" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Alderath system was first mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square L-7.<ref name="TEA" />
